title: Alternate Copper - Oxidized Copper Palette
description: Recolors copper items to an oxidized version.
body:
# Alternate Copper - Oxidized Copper Palette
This texture pack turns some copper items into their oxidized version.

You are allowed to modify and redistribute this texture pack, with credit to me, since this is just a proof of concept.

<details>
<summary>Main Features</summary>
  
- Oxidizes some copper items.
- Swaps palette when necessary.
</details>


<details>
<summary>Requirements</summary>

- Vanilla resource pack.
- Ignore the incompability warning in the current snapshots
</details>
